title: Lipoprotein Binding Protein (LBP)-Endotoxemia Assay
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrhfv36

steps.title: Dilute Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute mouse plasma or serum samples at a ratio of 1:800.

steps.title: Add Standards and Samples
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl of standards (50, 25, 12.5, 6.25, 3.12, 1.56 ng/ml) or diluted samples in duplicate into the corresponding wells of the precoated modules.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for one hour at room temperature while shaking at 300rpm.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the wells 3X with Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Add Detecting Antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl detecting antibody to each well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 1 hour on a shaker.

steps.title: Second Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the wells 3X with Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Add Substrate Solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl Substrate solution to each well.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 12-14 min in the dark at room temperature without shaking.
Cover with foil during incubation or place in a drawer.

steps.title: Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Add 100 μl stopping solution to each well and tap gently to mix.

steps.title: Read Absorbance
steps.instruction: Read absorbance at 450 nm using a reference wavelength of 620 nm.

steps.title: Calculate LBP Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the LBP concentration using the standard curve and sample OD.

substeps.instruction: Plot the OD means of standards (y-axis) against the LBP concentration (x-axis).
Calculate the LBP concentration from the mean OD of samples using the standard curve.
Multiply the result by the dilution factor.
